001package com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.econ.impl;
002
003import com.fs.starfarer.api.Global;
004import com.fs.starfarer.api.campaign.PlanetAPI;
005import com.fs.starfarer.api.impl.campaign.ids.Commodities;
006import com.fs.starfarer.api.util.Pair;
007
008
009public class LightIndustry extends BaseIndustry {
010
011        public void apply() {
012                super.apply(true);
013                
014                int size = market.getSize();
015                
016                demand(Commodities.ORGANICS, size);
017                
018                supply(Commodities.DOMESTIC_GOODS, size);
019                //supply(Commodities.SUPPLIES, size - 3);
020                        
021                //if (!market.getFaction().isIllegal(Commodities.LUXURY_GOODS)) {
022                if (!market.isIllegal(Commodities.LUXURY_GOODS)) {
023                        supply(Commodities.LUXURY_GOODS, size - 2);
024                } else {
025                        supply(Commodities.LUXURY_GOODS, 0);
026                }
027                //if (!market.getFaction().isIllegal(Commodities.DRUGS)) {
028                if (!market.isIllegal(Commodities.DRUGS)) {
029                        supply(Commodities.DRUGS, size - 2);
030                } else {
031                        supply(Commodities.DRUGS, 0);
032                }
033                
034                Pair<String, Integer> deficit = getMaxDeficit(Commodities.ORGANICS);
035                
036                applyDeficitToProduction(1, deficit,
037                                        Commodities.DOMESTIC_GOODS,
038                                        Commodities.LUXURY_GOODS,
039                                        //Commodities.SUPPLIES,
040                                        Commodities.DRUGS);
041                
042                if (!isFunctional()) {
043                        supply.clear();
044                }
045        }
046
047        
048        @Override
049        public void unapply() {
050                super.unapply();
051        }
052        
053        @Override
054        public String getCurrentImage() {
055                float size = market.getSize();
056                PlanetAPI planet = market.getPlanetEntity();
057                if (planet == null || planet.isGasGiant()) {
058                        if (size <= SIZE_FOR_SMALL_IMAGE) {
059                                return Global.getSettings().getSpriteName("industry", "light_industry_orbital_low");
060                        }
061                        if (size >= SIZE_FOR_LARGE_IMAGE) {
062                                return Global.getSettings().getSpriteName("industry", "light_industry_orbital_high");
063                        }
064                        return Global.getSettings().getSpriteName("industry", "light_industry_orbital");
065                }
066                else
067                {
068                        if (size <= SIZE_FOR_SMALL_IMAGE) {
069                                return Global.getSettings().getSpriteName("industry", "light_industry_low");
070                        }
071                        if (size >= SIZE_FOR_LARGE_IMAGE) {
072                                return Global.getSettings().getSpriteName("industry", "light_industry_high");
073                        }
074                }
075                
076                return super.getCurrentImage();
077        }
078
079        @Override
080        protected boolean canImproveToIncreaseProduction() {
081                return true;
082        }
083}
